sourceTitle: Tried for Her Life A Sequel to "Cruel As the Grave"
description: "Tried for Her Life" by Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth is a novel written in the late 19th century. This work serves as a sequel to "Cruel as the Grave" and follows the harrowing experiences of the main character, Sybil, who is thrust into peril after being abducted.
